description:
Port upstream google.ts + google-shared.ts as new umbrella app octo_pi_ai_google.

Google's Generative AI REST API (generativelanguage.googleapis.com). Uses API key auth (simpler than Vertex).

**Scope:**
- Request builder: convert Context to Google's generateContent format
  - Parts-based content (text, inline_data for images, function_call/response)
  - Tool declarations with OpenAPI-style function schemas
  - System instruction as separate field
  - Safety settings, generation config (temperature, topP, topK, maxOutputTokens)
- Decoder: SSE stream of GenerateContentResponse chunks → canonical events
  - candidates[0].content.parts → text deltas, function calls
  - usageMetadata → token counts
  - finishReason mapping (STOP, MAX_TOKENS, SAFETY, etc.)
- Thinking/reasoning support (thinkingConfig with thinkingBudget)
- Producer + Provider + Application wiring
- API key from GOOGLE_API_KEY or GEMINI_API_KEY env

**Upstream ref:** google.ts (500 lines), google-shared.ts (354 lines)
title: Google Generative AI provider (octo_pi_ai_google)
